title: Innokin Kwik 35K lemon Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Lemon Lime delivers a bright, citrus-forward blend of tangy Lemon and sharp Lime for a crisp, refreshing vape that stays lively throughout use. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container designed for the Innokin Kwik 10+2 device, providing consistent flavour and long-lasting use between changes. The mesh-coil pod ensures even heating for clean flavour, while the dual-chamber auto-feed system maintains steady coil saturation. This MTL (mouth-to-lung) format produces discreet vapour and balanced Nic Salt delivery at 20mg strength. How to Set Up Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Kwik 10+2 device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace the pod pack once both chambers are empty. ✅ You're all set!
